newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Acer '96 net profit down 45 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Acer '96 net profit down 45 pct yr/yr.

text.p: NOTE - Acer Inc is Taiwan's largest computer firm. The company has attributed the 1996 sales and net profit declines to slowing personal computer sales in the United States and falling semiconductor prices overseas.
But a company statement said it expected to report better performances in 1997.
"The second quarter will be better than the first, the second half year will be better than the first half," it said.
At a board meeting, the company proposed a T$2.5 stock dividend per share for 1996, the statement said.

The meeting also proposed to increase its investment ceiling in the mainland to US$25 million from US$5 million. The proposal needs the shareholders' approval at a meeting slated for May 28. -- Taipei Newsroom (5080815)
